title: It's Me!
text: Hello! I’m Leo, I’m nine, and my life is an adventure! I wake up at 7 o’clock, brush my teeth, and fuel up with cereal. I go to school at 8:30 because I love learning! After homework, it’s playtime. I want to be a vet when I grow up. Life is busy, but it’s a good day!

title: My School
text: My school is awesome! I have many subjects, and I especially love learning new things about animals. My teacher is kind, and I always try to be a good pupil. After school, I do my homework first – booo! – but then the real fun begins. School is fun when you love what you do!

title: My Friends and Family
text: I’m lucky to have a wonderful family and great friends! My best friend is Sam. We build amazing LEGO cities and play football. Chloe is fantastic at art, and Ben is the king of jokes! We also have my little sister Mia. She’s six and very funny. We all have fun together!

title: In My Schoolbag
text: This is my schoolbag. It’s not just for books! I have my homework, a cool ruler, and three books about wild animals. Lions are my favourite! Oh, and maybe a small cookie from my mum. My schoolbag is nice, but it’s a bit heavy with all these amazing things!

title: Clothes and Weather
text: The weather changes a lot, so my wardrobe is ready! When it’s sunny, I wear a t-shirt and shorts for football. When it’s rainy, I put on my raincoat and wellies to splash in puddles! If it’s cold, I wear a jumper, hat, and gloves. I love bright colours, even when the sky is grey!

title: School Subjects and Free Time
text: I love my free time! I really like playing video games online with my friends – we build amazing things. I also love drawing superheroes. On Saturdays, I go to swimming lessons for good exercise, and on Sundays, we visit my grandparents. Free time is the best!

title: Toys and Games
text: I have got some cool things to play with! My favourite is my LEGO sets – Sam and I build fast cars and big castles. I also have a football for the park. But my absolute favourite toy is my golden retriever, Buddy! He is fluffy, and we love playing fetch together.

title: My Hobby: Animals
text: I love animals, big and small! I have a golden retriever called Buddy. He is my best pet ever! I also love wild animals. At the zoo, I saw monkeys swinging and elephants splashing. They were amazing! I read lots of books about them because I want to be a vet.

title: Food and Shopping
text: I LOVE food! For breakfast, I have cereal with milk and a banana for energy. Lunch is my favourite: a ham and cheese sandwich and an apple. Sometimes my mum packs cookies! For dinner, we eat pasta, chicken, or fish with vegetables. I don’t always like vegetables, but I try! Yummy!

title: Summer Holidays
text: Summer is here, and the weather is hot and sunny! It’s perfect for playing football in the park. Sometimes we go to the zoo or visit my grandparents in the country. I can swim, run, and play outside. I like summer holidays. They are the best! What’s the weather like where you are?
